subject: [PATCH v3 17/18] selftests/mm: add memory-pressure threads to the khugepaged race harness

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch adds two new threads to the khugepaged race harness: pageout and compactor. The pageout thread simulates memory pressure by cycling MADV_PAGEOUT on a dedicated neighbor region, while the compactor thread triggers compaction by writing to /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory in a loop. These threads are designed to compete with the collapse for pages, causing refcount elevations and migration entries. The patch also introduces new command-line options to narrow down the test runs based on these new threads.
